model.title: High-Capacity Grid Act
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Julie Fedorchak (R-ND)

summary.text: The bill would require electric utilities to use the most advanced, high-capacity power line conductors available for new interstate transmission projects or upgrades to existing ones. It aims to make it easier for utilities to recover the costs of these superior conductors through consumer electric bills by directing federal regulators to presume that using the best-available conductor is a prudent, reasonable practice, while using lesser conductors would not be.
